contracts: (A Replay Result is successful only when an independently executed Probe verification is present and passes.) AND (A non-matching target yields a rejection terminal state and zero downstream processing events.) AND (A verdict is terminally valid only if source identity and execution evidence validate and narrative text contributes no decision input.) AND (All aggregate records have a terminal state, no execution exceeds bounds, and equivalent executions produce the same terminal state.) AND (For every Consumer Manifest entry, all applicable route transitions have completed and each has a recorded post-rollback Prior Behavior Baseline observation; aggregate completed transitions equals aggregate applicable transitions (100%).) AND (No success verdict exists unless identity and execution facts are both current and independently verifiable.) AND (Pass only when all bound identities match and fresh terminal verdict equals the pinned reference; otherwise terminal status is stale or execution-failed.) AND (Replay success is publishable only when validator_capability verification independently passes and matches the Replay Result identity.) AND (Success can be emitted only when the independently recomputed snapshot identity and verification status match the Replay Result binding.) AND (Terminal only when elapsed time is recorded for each aggregate, is at or below its bound for success, and timeout or budget exhaustion is terminal non-success.) AND (Terminal only when every ambiguous identity or execution input yields deterministic non-success and none yields accepted success.) AND (Terminal only when every skipped-Consumer case is explicitly rejected or non-success and no skipped case can produce accepted success.) AND (当 evidence identity 已用于其他 case 或不新鲜时，success 必须为 false/rejected。) AND (成功结果仅当身份与执行事实都存在、匹配且验证通过；否则终态必须为 rejected/non-success。) AND (所有 success Replay Result 均有独立 target_verification.status=passed 且 identity_match=true。)

selector_intents: Bind the result to a different snapshot identity than the independently verified snapshot; validation must reject the result.
Execute the aggregate timeout harness with a deliberately over-budget aggregate; validation must observe timeout or budget exhaustion and reject success.

Exercise the bound Given/When against the real production entry. Only a failing assertion of the unchanged observable and expected outcome may emit this marker. Expected subject rejection is a passing test when the oracle requires rejection. Import, setup, process launch, timeout and infrastructure faults must never emit this marker. Observable: A machine-readable route-transition evaluation result contains one completed record for each manifest entry and applicable transition, includes rollback baseline observations, and its aggregate completion count equals the manifest transition count. Expected: The evaluator executes every applicable route transition for every Consumer Manifest entry, records completion and post-rollback Prior Behavior Baseline observations per entry, and reports 100% completion with no skipped or incomplete applicable transitions.

Expected: Every terminating aggregate record contains a terminal state selected deterministically from the execution outcome; equivalent repeated runs yield the same terminal state and budget exhaustion is unsuccessful.

Observable: Replay Result JSON contains a distinct validator_capability verification record with identity binding and pass outcome. Exercise the bound Given/When against the real production entry. Only a failing assertion of the unchanged observable and expected outcome may emit this marker. Observable: Replay Result records matching terminal verdict, bound input identities, dependency identities, and freshness status from an independently launched process. Expected: Fresh-checkout replay reconstructs the terminal semantic verdict equal to the pinned-input reference verdict, with no unexplained bound-input drift.
Mutate one pinned result-determining input in a fresh-checkout replay and require stale/failed output instead of a reproduced verdict.
Omit or make unverifiable the execution freshness fact; operation terminates non-success with an explicit unverifiable-freshness reason.
Replay an equivalent aggregate execution twice with divergent terminal outcomes; assert the determinism check fails.
Replay with a stale or mismatched candidate identity; the gate rejects success and reports identity mismatch.
Run Replay Result validation with probe_verification absent or not independently executed despite replay success.
Run the SM-2 skipped-Consumer case through the semantic-verdict validator; it must fail if the case is reported successful.
Run the aggregate evaluator with a fixture exceeding the configured time or output budget; assert bounded termination with an unsuccessful terminal state.
Run the existing semantic-gate validator against a case with an ambiguous or unverifiable identity/execution fact; it must fail if the result is accepted as success.
Run the manifest evaluation with a transition result missing its post-rollback Prior Behavior Baseline observation; validation must reject the result as incomplete.

Run the route-transition evaluation against a non-empty Consumer Manifest fixture with at least one applicable transition intentionally omitted or marked incomplete; the evaluator must fail or report completion below 100%.
Run the successful replay fixture with the validator_capability verification record removed or mismatched; success must be rejected.
Submit a verdict whose only support is assistant prose and no current source identity or execution evidence; validation must reject it.
Supply a target fixture with a deliberately substituted identity; the gate must reject it before any processing occurs.
Use a successful replay fixture with snapshot verification removed; runtime validation must fail the result.
